data.value: The two founders of the Tidepool app have been at odds over strategy since spring. Will they announce a buyout of one side to their twelve employees within the next three months?

Tidepool is an app company with twelve employees. The two founders have equal ownership and decision-making power. The employees are aware of the founders' disagreement but not of any specific buyout plans. The company has no formal process for buyouts; any announcement would be made by the founders to the employees.
